images.title: Tortoise on the path
images.purpose: Set the hook: the tortoise covers only 1/4 km in 1 hour, a fraction of a kilometre.
images.composition: One long horizontal garden path centred in the frame, the tortoise sitting at the first quarter mark, lots of white space above and below.
exact_structure: One horizontal path drawn as a grey #6B7280 line from 0 to 1 km, with 5 tick marks: 0, 1/4, 1/2, 3/4, 1 at equal spacing.
A simple flat green #009E73 tortoise (no face needed) standing above the tick at 1/4.
The segment from 0 to 1/4 is thickened in amber #E69F00.
A small teal #0072B2 arrow below the thick segment pointing from 0 to 1/4.
rejection: other than 5 ticks or 4 equal gaps
extra scenery or a second animal
images.takeaway: The tortoise's distance in 1 hour is a fraction of a kilometre, less than 1 km.
images.description: A tortoise on a path marked from 0 to 1 km, standing at the 1/4 km mark.
images.context: Shown beside the concept text and video.
images.teaching_notes: Look at how short the amber stretch is compared with the whole kilometre.

image_decisions.why: A simple path picture sets up the question of what happens in a fraction of an hour.
